The project is deliberately kept as a single package to avoid exposing internal symbols unnecessarily.\n- Keep handlers grouped by domain in the existing `handlers_*.go` files. Add a new file only when a domain is large enough to warrant its own boundary.\n- Pure calculation logic belongs in `rules.go`; persistence logic belongs in `db.go`; types belong in `models.go`.\n- All JSON responses are produced via `writeJSON` so the `Content-Type` header and encoding error logging are consistent.\n- Status codes are part of the observable contract: use `http.StatusOK` for successful reads, `http.StatusCreated` for successful creation, and the standard 400/401/404/409 helpers for errors.\n- Unique-constraint failures are detected by checking whether the SQLite error string contains `UNIQUE constraint failed`.\n- Map iteration order is non-deterministic. Avoid relying on it for any response field that tests compare exactly.\n- The service is deterministic by design: dice handlers compute min/max/average rather than rolling; bcrypt cost is the default; no randomness is used.\n- To test locally, start the server with `./run.sh` and use `curl` against
